About me:

I am a PhD candidate at the University of Strathclyde, under the supervision of
[Vikraman Choudry](Vikraman.org). Before that I was a PhD candidate at the University
of Edinburgh where I was supervised by [Francesco Tudisco](ftudisco.gitlab.io).

My research interests focus on low dimensional categories and their
applications to linear logic: this includes 2-categories, double categories and
multicategories.

I obtained my MSc from the University of Glasgow.

Please get in contact with me at r.jack.heaney@removethis.gmail.andthis.com
